8	/// run the sheet is dismissed out from under, and File ▸ Generate
9	/// Captions… itself with the validator arm that greys it.
10	///
11	/// A pure move out of `TranscribeSheetController.swift`, road map 6's C1
12	/// toll 3. Both blocks came here whole and in their own order, with every
13	/// line byte-identical. One widening in the move — `finish` is internal
14	/// rather than `private`, which the compiler forces, since `begin` stayed
15	/// behind and calls it — and nine in the file it left, the stored
16	/// properties `finish` and `viewDidDisappear` read. `summary` stays
17	/// `private`: only `finish` calls it, and it moved with it. W2 deleted
18	/// `truncationText` with the ceiling it reported (spec §11 W-8).
19	///
20	/// **c1-chrome added the cloud engine's three lines** (road map 6 §5e), and
21	/// it is no longer only a move. `cloudReportLines` turns the run's `Report`
22	/// into what the card says beside today's counts — R6-8's fallback, the
23	/// language that was DETECTED and how sure the service was, and any media
24	/// whose remote delete is still owed. They are added in BOTH arms: a run
25	/// that failed can still have uploaded one media and owe a delete for it,
26	/// and a card that printed only the error would lose the one record a
27	/// person has of that.
28	extension TranscribeSheetController {
29	
30	    // MARK: - Commit
31	
32	    /// The one exit for all four outcomes — finished, finished with something
33	    /// to say, failed and cancelled.
34	    ///
35	    /// The plan is built HERE, against the document's CURRENT handle, not
36	    /// against the snapshot this sheet opened with: recognition is minutes
37	    /// long and an agent can edit a document while a sheet is up, and
38	    /// `CaptionLayout.place` reads ids off a probe of the handle it is given.
39	    /// The commit goes through `performGroupedEdit` because a queue completion
40	    /// is not an AppKit event — the road map says `applyEdit` here, and
41	    /// following it would silently merge the captions into whatever edit came
42	    /// before them (app/CLAUDE.md's undo pitfall).
43	    func finish(_ outcome: Result<Transcriber.Outcome, any Error>) {
44	        guard !didFinish else { return }
45	        didFinish = true
46	        bar.doubleValue = 1
47	        stopButton.title = "Close"
48	        stopButton.isEnabled = true
49	        detailLabel.stringValue = ""
50	
51	        let cloudLines = cloudReport.map {
52	            Self.cloudReportLines($0, names: mediaNames, detected: cloudDetected)
53	        } ?? []
54	        let result: Transcriber.Outcome
55	        switch outcome {
56	        case .failure(let error):
57	            statusLabel.stringValue = ([error.localizedDescription] + cloudLines)
58	                .joined(separator: "\n")
59	            statusLabel.textColor = DS.textStrong
60	            return
61	        case .success(let value):
62	            result = value
63	        }
64	        guard let document = document else {
65	            statusLabel.stringValue = "The project closed before the captions could be placed."
66	            return
67	        }
68	        let plan: CaptionLayout.Plan
69	        do {
70	            let replacing = replaceExisting
71	                ? CaptionLayout.replaceableTracks(
72	                    in: document.editedProject.snapshot, jobs: jobs(in: scope))
73	                : []
74	            plan = try CaptionLayout.place(
75	                result.cues, problems: result.problems, in: document.editedProject,
76	                style: style, looks: looks, replacing: replacing)
77	        } catch {
78	            statusLabel.stringValue = error.localizedDescription
79	            statusLabel.textColor = DS.textStrong
80	            return
81	        }
82	        document.performGroupedEdit("Generate Captions", plan.ops)
83	
84	        // A clean run has nothing to say that the timeline does not already
85	        // show, so it leaves rather than making the user dismiss a receipt.
86	        guard plan.report.isEmpty, cloudLines.isEmpty else {
87	            statusLabel.stringValue =
88	                ([summary(plan), plan.report] + cloudLines)
89	                .filter { !$0.isEmpty }.joined(separator: "\n")
90	            statusLabel.textColor = DS.textStrong
91	            return
92	        }
93	        dismiss(self)
94	    }
95	
96	    /// The media names this sheet opened with, by id — the report card names
97	    /// FILES, because a person chose files and an id is the tool's
98	    /// vocabulary.
99	    private var mediaNames: [UInt32: String] {
100	        var out: [UInt32: String] = [:]
101	        for entry in snapshot.media { out[entry.id] = entry.name }
102	        return out
103	    }
104	
105	    /// The cloud run's extra lines, in a fixed order: R6-8's fallback, the
106	    /// detected language, what is still owed a delete, then any fetched
107	    /// transcript that could not be kept for reuse.
108	    ///
109	    /// The owed list is `Report.deletionWarnings`'s rule: once per media
110	    /// id, because a media can be in `janitorFailed` (an id owed from an
111	    /// earlier run) AND in `uploaded` with `remoteDeleted` false (one owed
112	    /// from this run), and saying it twice would read as two transcripts. A
113	    /// media R6-11 HELD gets one more clause, because "it will be retried"
114	    /// is only half of what happened to it.
115	    static func cloudReportLines(
116	        _ report: CloudTranscriber.Report, names: [UInt32: String], detected: Bool
117	    ) -> [String] {
118	        func name(_ id: UInt32) -> String { names[id] ?? "media \(id)" }
119	        var lines: [String] = []
120	        let preferred = TranscriptOptions.shippedModels.first ?? "universal-3-5-pro"
121	        for row in report.uploaded {
122	            guard let model = row.speechModelUsed, model != preferred else { continue }
123	            lines.append(
124	                "“\(name(row.media))” was transcribed with \(model), not \(preferred).")
125	        }
126	        if detected {
127	            for row in report.uploaded {
128	                guard let code = row.languageCode else { continue }
129	                let spoken = AssemblyAILanguages.entry(code: code)?.displayName ?? code
130	                guard let confidence = row.languageConfidence else {
131	                    lines.append("“\(name(row.media))”: detected \(spoken).")
132	                    continue
133	                }
134	                let percent = Int((min(max(confidence, 0), 1) * 100).rounded())
135	                lines.append(
136	                    "“\(name(row.media))”: detected \(spoken) (\(percent)% confidence).")
137	            }
138	        }
139	        lines.append(contentsOf: report.deletionWarnings { "“\(name($0))”" })
140	        lines.append(contentsOf: report.cacheWarnings { "“\(name($0))”" })
141	        return lines
142	    }
143	
144	    private func summary(_ plan: CaptionLayout.Plan) -> String {
145	        "\(plan.clips) caption\(plan.clips == 1 ? "" : "s") added"
146	            + (plan.trackName.map { " on “\($0)”." } ?? ".")
147	    }
148	
149	    override func viewDidDisappear() {
150	        super.viewDidDisappear()
151	        // A sheet that goes away mid-run must not leave a recognition holding
152	        // a temporary file and somebody's compute.
153	        if didStart, !didFinish { token.cancel() }
154	    }
155	}

159	/// The command half, at the foot of the file that owns the feature —
160	/// `CaptionImporter.swift`'s precedent, which keeps File ▸ Import Captions…
161	/// beside the importer it opens.

163	
164	    /// File ▸ Generate Captions… — the body of the frozen file's one-line
165	    /// `@objc func generateCaptions(_:)` forward.
166	    ///
167	    /// The refusal happens HERE rather than in the sheet, so a dialog whose
168	    /// only possible answer is "there is nothing with speech in it" never
169	    /// opens — `removeSilencesCommand`'s rule.
170	    func generateCaptionsCommand() {
171	        guard let document = document, view.window?.attachedSheet == nil else {
172	            NSSound.beep()
173	            return
174	        }
175	        guard Transcriber.hasTranscribableClip(in: document.editedProject.snapshot) else {
176	            NSSound.beep()
177	            return
178	        }
179	        // Recognition is minutes of somebody else's compute and the sheet is

185	    /// The half of `validateUserInterfaceItem` this file owns. nil means "not
186	    /// mine" and leaves the other answers alone.

188	        guard let document = document else { return false }
189	        switch action {
190	        case #selector(EditorViewController.generateCaptions(_:)):
191	            return Transcriber.hasTranscribableClip(in: document.editedProject.snapshot)
192	        default:
193	            return nil
194	        }
195	    }
196	}

5	/// The caption STYLE on the Generate Captions card — road map 8 §5e, W4b:

23	/// nothing is hand-drawn here but the plate and the scaling. A word style

42	        let canvas: CGSize
43	        var looks = CaptionLooks.none
44	    }
45	
46	    /// How far through its fill the preview draws the active word.

164	    /// "Replaces “Captions” (12 captions), “Captions 2” (3 captions)." — the

175	    // MARK: - The preview
176	
177	    /// `sampleText`'s five tokens, one every 0.3 s from 0, each 0.18 s long.
178	    static var fixedSampleWords: [CaptionCues.Word] {
179	        sampleText.split(separator: " ").enumerated().map { index, token in
180	            let start = Ticks(index) * 180_000
181	            return CaptionCues.Word(text: String(token), start: start, end: start + 108_000)
182	        }
183	    }

185	    /// The words the preview pages: the first job's own words, up to twelve,
186	    /// when a cached transcript already has them, else `fixedSampleWords`.
187	    /// The ANSWER is cached per clip, a miss included — `refresh` runs per
188	    /// keystroke, and `MediaTranscript.read` is a disk read hit or miss.
189	    func sampleWords() -> [CaptionCues.Word] {
190	        guard let job = jobs(in: scope).first else { return Self.fixedSampleWords }
191	        if let cached = sampleWordsCache[job.clip] { return cached }
192	        var words: [CaptionCues.Word] = []
193	        if let directory = document?.cacheDirectory,
194	            let file = MediaTranscript.read(for: job.media, in: directory)
195	        {
196	            words = Array(MediaTranscript.captionWords(for: job, in: file).prefix(12))
197	        }
198	        let answer = words.isEmpty ? Self.fixedSampleWords : words
199	        sampleWordsCache[job.clip] = answer
200	        return answer
201	    }

203	    /// The page's text props as `CaptionLayout.place` writes them: a word
204	    /// style's are `CaptionStyle.textProps` at the page's own size and width —
205	    /// the one construction the pager measured and `pagePatch` commits, with
206	    /// the sheet's `looks` as `place` is handed them — and Subtitles' are the
207	    /// Caption preset with its wrap box, mirrored.
208	    func previewProps(for cue: CaptionLayout.Cue, canvas: CGSize) -> TextProps {
209	        guard style.isWordStyle else {
210	            let preset = CaptionLayout.captionPreset
211	            return TextProps(
212	                content: cue.text, font: preset.font,
213	                size: preset.size(on: canvas),
214	                align: preset.align, valign: "middle", backdrop: preset.backdrop,
215	                width: Double(canvas.width) * CaptionLayout.wrapFraction)
216	        }
217	        return style.textProps(
218	            content: cue.text, size: cue.size ?? style.size(for: canvas), width: cue.width,
219	            looks: looks)
220	    }

222	    /// A word style's two preview frames: the first word active, then the
223	    /// second (the first again on a one-word page), each with the fill at
224	    /// `previewFill` when Fill is on, and the second with the pill at
225	    /// `previewGlide` when Slide is on and there is a word to slide from.
226	    static func previewReveals(tokens: Int, looks: CaptionLooks) -> [RecipeReveal] {
227	        let fill = looks.fill ? previewFill : nil
228	        let glide = looks.slide && tokens >= 2 ? previewGlide : nil
229	        return [
230	            RecipeReveal(word: 1, wordPop: 1, wordFill: fill),
231	            RecipeReveal(word: min(2, tokens), wordPop: 1, wordGlide: glide, wordFill: fill),
232	        ]
233	    }
234	
235	    /// The sample page drawn by the renderer: two frames for a word style
236	    /// (`previewReveals`), one for Subtitles, each
237	    /// scaled to fit a 258×36 slot, stacked 8 pt apart over the plate, at 2×.
238	    func preview() -> NSImage? {
239	        let canvas = CGSize(width: snapshot.canvas.width, height: snapshot.canvas.height)
240	        let frame = max(snapshot.canvas.fps.frameDuration, 1)
241	        guard
242	            let cue = CaptionPages.samplePage(
243	                sampleWords(), request: pagesRequest, frame: frame)
244	        else { return nil }
245	        let props = previewProps(for: cue, canvas: canvas)
246	        let reveals =
247	            style.isWordStyle
248	            ? Self.previewReveals(tokens: props.tokenCount, looks: looks)
249	            : [RecipeReveal.whole]
250	        let size = Self.previewSize
251	        let scale: CGFloat = 2
252	        guard
253	            let context = LayerRenderers.bitmap(
254	                CGSize(width: size.width * scale, height: size.height * scale))
255	        else { return nil }
256	        context.setFillColor(DS.captionPreviewPlate.cgColor)
257	        context.fill(CGRect(x: 0, y: 0, width: context.width, height: context.height))
258	        context.scaleBy(x: scale, y: scale)
259	        context.interpolationQuality = .high
260	
261	        let slot = CGSize(width: size.width, height: 36)
262	        let gap: CGFloat = 8
263	        let count = CGFloat(reveals.count)
264	        // From the TOP, in points; the context is y-up.
265	        var top = (size.height - count * slot.height - (count - 1) * gap) / 2
266	        for reveal in reveals {
267	            if let bitmap = LayerRenderers.textBitmap(props, reveal: reveal),
268	                let image = bitmap.makeImage()
269	            {
270	                let fit = min(
271	                    slot.width / CGFloat(image.width), slot.height / CGFloat(image.height))
272	                let drawn = CGSize(
273	                    width: CGFloat(image.width) * fit, height: CGFloat(image.height) * fit)
274	                context.draw(
275	                    image,
276	                    in: CGRect(
277	                        x: (size.width - drawn.width) / 2,
278	                        y: size.height - top - slot.height + (slot.height - drawn.height) / 2,
279	                        width: drawn.width, height: drawn.height))
280	            }
281	            top += slot.height + gap
282	        }
283	        guard let image = context.makeImage() else { return nil }
284	        return NSImage(cgImage: image, size: size)
285	    }

5	/// The three LOOKS on the Generate Captions card (spec §11 W-15, issue batch
6	/// B86): "Slide the pill", "Fill words as spoken" and "Dim in pauses", one
7	/// per line under the Style popup and above the preview, and the note about
8	/// on-device pauses under them.
9	///
10	/// **A box that does not apply is greyed, not hidden, and keeps its tick.**
11	/// `refreshLooksRow()` sets each box's `isEnabled` from
12	/// `CaptionLooks.Look.isLive(for:)` and never its state, so Slide ticked on
13	/// Pill is still ticked after a trip through Karaoke; `looks` counts a box
14	/// only while it is ENABLED and on, which is what `finish` hands `place` and
15	/// what the preview draws.
16	///
17	/// **Each box is remembered under its own key**, read when the row is built
18	/// and written by a CLICK (`lookChanged`) — never by Generate — and never by

20	/// remembered only a style opens with all three off.

23	/// word style), ticked or not: the on-device engine's word ranges tile the
24	/// audio, so its words rarely carry the pause a dim waits for (W-13). It
25	/// wraps to two lines at the column's width, so the card is about two lines
26	/// taller while it shows.

29	    /// The owner's sentence (spec §11 W-15).
30	    static let dimNote = "On-device words rarely carry a pause; this shows mostly with AssemblyAI."
31	
32	    /// The looks a run commits: each box ENABLED and on.
33	    var looks: CaptionLooks {
34	        var out = CaptionLooks.none
35	        for look in CaptionLooks.Look.allCases {
36	            let box = checkbox(for: look)
37	            out[look] = box.isEnabled && box.state == .on
38	        }
39	        return out
40	    }
41	
42	    func checkbox(for look: CaptionLooks.Look) -> NSButton {
43	        switch look {
44	        case .slide: return slideCheckbox
45	        case .fill: return fillCheckbox
46	        case .dim: return dimCheckbox
47	        }
48	    }

50	    /// Grid row 8: the three boxes stacked, each opening on its remembered
51	    /// state, and the note. `makeReplaceRow()` is the pattern.
52	    func makeLooksRow() -> [NSView] {
53	        var views: [NSView] = []
54	        for look in CaptionLooks.Look.allCases {
55	            let box = checkbox(for: look)
56	            box.title = look.title
57	            box.font = DS.sans(12)
58	            box.target = self
59	            box.action = #selector(lookChanged(_:))
60	            box.state = defaults.bool(forKey: look.defaultsKey) ? .on : .off
61	            box.setAccessibilityIdentifier("captions.look.\(look.rawValue)")
62	            views.append(box)
63	        }

65	        dimNoteLabel.font = DS.sans(11)
66	        dimNoteLabel.textColor = DS.textMuted
67	        dimNoteLabel.isEditable = false
68	        dimNoteLabel.preferredMaxLayoutWidth = Self.previewSize.width
69	        dimNoteLabel.setAccessibilityIdentifier("captions.look.dimnote")
70	        views.append(dimNoteLabel)
71	        let stack = NSStackView(views: views)
72	        stack.orientation = .vertical
73	        stack.alignment = .leading
74	        stack.spacing = 4

77	
78	    /// A click on one box: remember THAT box's state under its own key, and
79	    /// recompute. The third `defaults.set` on this card, beside the engine's
80	    /// and the style's.
81	    @objc func lookChanged(_ sender: Any?) {
82	        let clicked = CaptionLooks.Look.allCases.first { checkbox(for: $0) === sender as? NSButton }
83	        if let look = clicked {
84	            defaults.set(checkbox(for: look).state == .on, forKey: look.defaultsKey)
85	        }
86	        refresh()
87	    }
88	
89	    /// Which boxes apply to the chosen style, and whether the note shows.
90	    /// Each box's STATE is left alone.
91	    func refreshLooksRow() {
92	        for look in CaptionLooks.Look.allCases {
93	            checkbox(for: look).isEnabled = look.isLive(for: style)
94	        }
95	        dimNoteLabel.isHidden = !(engine == .apple && dimCheckbox.isEnabled)
96	    }
97	}

3	// MARK: - Sheet: the Download row
4	
5	/// The row under Language that installs an on-device model — spec §11 W-8,
6	/// road map 8 §5f. It shows for a supported language whose model is not on
7	/// this Mac, and while a download runs; a person presses Download, watches the
8	/// bar, and may press Cancel.
9	///
10	/// **A download is a person's act, never a tool's** (R6-12's argument read
11	/// across): this row is `SpeechEngine.download`'s only caller, and the
12	/// `transcribe` tool refuses an uninstalled locale by name instead.
13	///
14	/// **The bar is indeterminate until the download says how big it is.** W0 q3
15	/// read the request's `Progress` before any download: zero units, zero
16	/// fraction. So the row names no size and no percentage until
17	/// `totalUnitCount` is positive, and then shows the fraction.
18	///
19	/// **Both popups are LOCKED while a download runs.** Changing the language
20	/// mid-download would hide the only Cancel or show one locale's bar under
21	/// another's name, and changing the engine would repopulate Language under
22	/// it; `downloading` names the locale the running download is for and the
23	/// row reads that, never the popup. The lock is applied in
24	/// `refreshDownloadRow()`, AFTER `populateLanguages()` has set the popup's
25	/// own `isEnabled` — never inside it.
26	///
27	/// **Closing the sheet mid-download is a decision, not code**: the download
28	/// runs on in the framework, and the observation dies with this controller
29	/// (`[weak self]`).
30	extension TranscribeSheetController {
31	
32	    /// Grid row 1: an empty label cell, and the button, the bar and the
33	    /// label in one stack.
34	    func makeDownloadRow() -> [NSView] {
35	        let button = NSButton(
36	            title: "Download", target: self, action: #selector(downloadClicked(_:)))
37	        button.bezelStyle = .rounded
38	        button.controlSize = .small
39	        button.font = DS.sans(12)
40	        let bar = NSProgressIndicator()
41	        bar.style = .bar
42	        bar.controlSize = .small
43	        bar.minValue = 0
44	        bar.maxValue = 1
45	        bar.isIndeterminate = true
46	        bar.widthAnchor.constraint(equalToConstant: 80).isActive = true
47	        let label = NSTextField(labelWithString: "")
48	        label.font = DS.sans(11)
49	        label.textColor = DS.textMuted
50	        label.lineBreakMode = .byTruncatingTail
51	        downloadButton = button
52	        downloadBar = bar
53	        downloadLabel = label
54	        let stack = NSStackView(views: [button, bar, label])
55	        stack.orientation = .horizontal
56	        stack.alignment = .centerY
57	        stack.spacing = 8
58	        return [fieldLabel(""), stack]
59	    }
60	
61	    /// The row's whole state, recomputed — `refresh()` calls it last, and
62	    /// every progress hop ends in it.
63	    func refreshDownloadRow() {
64	        guard let grid = grid, let button = downloadButton, let bar = downloadBar,
65	            let label = downloadLabel
66	        else { return }
67	        let running = downloading
68	        let visible = running != nil || (engine == .apple && language?.installed == false)
69	        if grid.numberOfRows > 1 { grid.row(at: 1).isHidden = !visible }
70	        guard let running else {
71	            button.title = "Download"
72	            button.isEnabled = true
73	            bar.isHidden = true
74	            bar.stopAnimation(nil)
75	            label.stringValue = ""
76	            return
77	        }
78	        languagePopup.isEnabled = false
79	        enginePopup.isEnabled = false
80	        button.title = "Cancel"
81	        // Nothing to cancel until the request's `Progress` has arrived: a
82	        // Cancel pressed before it would do nothing and the download run on.
83	        button.isEnabled = downloadProgress != nil
84	        bar.isHidden = false
85	        var text = "Downloading \(running.displayName)…"
86	        if let progress = downloadProgress, progress.totalUnitCount > 0 {
87	            bar.stopAnimation(nil)
88	            bar.isIndeterminate = false
89	            bar.doubleValue = min(max(progress.fractionCompleted, 0), 1)
90	            text += " \(Int(progress.fractionCompleted * 100))%"
91	        } else {
92	            bar.isIndeterminate = true
93	            bar.startAnimation(nil)
94	        }
95	        label.stringValue = text
96	    }
97	
98	    /// Download when none runs; Cancel the running one otherwise.
99	    @objc func downloadClicked(_ sender: Any?) {
100	        guard downloading == nil else {
101	            downloadProgress?.cancel()
102	            return
103	        }
104	        guard engine == .apple, let chosen = language, !chosen.installed else {
105	            NSSound.beep()
106	            return
107	        }
108	        downloading = chosen
109	        refreshDownloadRow()
110	        SpeechEngine.download(
111	            chosen.locale,
112	            progress: { [weak self] progress in self?.observe(progress) },
113	            completion: { [weak self] result in self?.downloadFinished(result) })
114	    }
115	
116	    /// Holds the request's `Progress` and watches its two numbers, each
117	    /// change hopped to main and ending in `refreshDownloadRow()`.
118	    private func observe(_ progress: Progress) {
119	        downloadProgress = progress
120	        downloadObservation = progress.observe(
121	            \.fractionCompleted, options: [.new]
122	        ) { [weak self] _, _ in
123	            DispatchQueue.main.async { self?.refreshDownloadRow() }
124	        }
125	        refreshDownloadRow()
126	    }
127	
128	    /// The completion's one-line forward. The downloaded locale is captured
129	    /// BEFORE `populateLanguages()` reselects the default, and selected
130	    /// again after it. A cancel is not reported; any other failure is one
131	    /// line in the note until the next refresh.
132	    func downloadFinished(_ result: Result<Void, any Error>) {
133	        let identifier = downloading?.identifier
134	        let cancelled = downloadProgress?.isCancelled ?? false
135	        downloading = nil
136	        downloadProgress = nil
137	        downloadObservation = nil
138	        enginePopup.isEnabled = true
139	        switch result {
140	        case .success:
141	            Transcriber.forgetLanguages()
142	            languages = Transcriber.supportedLanguages()
143	            populateLanguages()
144	            if let identifier { select(languageIdentifier: identifier) }
145	            refresh()
146	        case .failure(let error):
147	            populateLanguages()
148	            if let identifier { select(languageIdentifier: identifier) }
149	            refresh()
150	            guard !cancelled, !(error is CancellationError) else { return }
151	            noteLabel.stringValue = "The download did not finish: \(error.localizedDescription)"
152	            noteLabel.isHidden = false
153	        }
154	    }
155	
156	    /// Selects the Language row whose identifier this is; a miss keeps
157	    /// whatever `populateLanguages()` chose.
158	    func select(languageIdentifier: String) {
159	        if let index = languagePopup.itemArray.firstIndex(where: {
160	            $0.representedObject as? String == languageIdentifier
161	        }) {
162	            languagePopup.selectItem(at: index)
163	        }
164	    }
165	}

3	/// File ▸ Generate Captions… — road map 2 phase 4a's dialog: a language, a
4	/// scope, and then the same card turned into a progress bar while
5	/// `Transcriber` works.
6	///
7	/// **One sheet, two states, and that is deliberate.**
8	/// `ConsolidateProgressSheetController` already changes its own buttons and
9	/// labels mid-run, and `ExportProgressSheetController` puts the reason best:
10	/// success and failure both turn the sheet into its own result panel rather
11	/// than trading it for an alert. Presenting a SECOND sheet from this one's
12	/// action is the thing `ReverseProgressSheetController.viewDidDisappear`
13	/// records as not working here — a sheet dismissed a moment ago is still
14	/// `window.attachedSheet` and the next presentation is refused. Staying one
15	/// sheet also keeps the bargain that lets this card be trusted: every editor
16	/// action validates false while a sheet is attached, so the clips it counted
17	/// in `init` are the clips that will be transcribed.
18	///
19	/// **A model is installed HERE and nowhere else** (spec §11 W-8). The
20	/// Language popup lists every locale the engine supports, a row whose model
21	/// is missing marked "— not installed", and choosing one shows the Download
22	/// row (`TranscribeSheetController+Download.swift`): a download is a
23	/// person's act, so the `transcribe` tool refuses such a locale by name and
24	/// never downloads. Generate is live only for an installed language. No grant
25	/// is asked for and no ceiling is reported: W0 q1 measured neither.
26	///
27	/// **Two engines, one card (road map 6 §5e).** An Engine popup under
28	/// Language chooses between the recogniser on this Mac and AssemblyAI, and
29	/// the choice re-populates Language, shows or hides the three cloud rows, and
30	/// changes the hint. `TranscribeSheetController+Cloud.swift` holds everything
31	/// that is only about the cloud engine; what is HERE is the card, and three
32	/// methods — `refresh`, `noteText` and `startClicked` — whose FIRST statement
33	/// dispatches on the engine. That order is load-bearing: under
34	/// `.assemblyai` none of the three reads `language` or `languages`, so a Mac
35	/// with no on-device model can still transcribe in the cloud.
36	///
37	/// **The widenings this split cost**, in toll 3's pattern: `languages`,
38	/// `mediaURLs`, `languagePopup`, `summaryLabel`, `noteLabel`, `hintLabel`,
39	/// `scope`, `jobs(in:)`, `startButton`, `showProgress()` and `progressed(_:_:)`
40	/// are internal rather than private, because `+Cloud.swift` builds the same
41	/// card out of them. W2 widened `language`, `grid` and `refresh()` for the
42	/// Download row's file; the cloud half still reads none of them.
43	///
44	/// **The Style row and what hangs under it** are two more files:
45	/// `TranscribeSheetController+Style.swift` (the Style popup, the preview and
46	/// Replace) and `TranscribeSheetController+Looks.swift` (the three look
47	/// checkboxes and the on-device note, spec §11 W-15). What is HERE for them
48	/// is their stored views and their grid rows.
49	///
50	/// **Four injection points, for the probe and for nothing else.** `store`,
51	/// `defaults`, `environment` and `languages` are initialiser arguments with
52	/// the app's own values as defaults, so an instrument can build this sheet
53	/// with an empty `MemoryStore`, a throwaway defaults suite, no environment
54	/// and no on-device model at all, and measure what a person would see.

490	                // `ConsolidateProgressSheetController` bounces its.
491	                DispatchQueue.main.async { self?.progressed(fraction, name) }

5	/// Everything on the Generate Captions card that is only about AssemblyAI —
6	/// road map 6 §5e. The Language popup's second population, what the controls
7	/// ADD UP TO (`RunRequest`), the readout the estimate writes, the two hint
8	/// sentences, the notes, and the run itself.
9	///
10	/// **It is a file of its own for `AgentServer+CloudCaptions.swift`'s reason,
11	/// read across to the chrome.** The on-device half of this sheet is a story
12	/// about an installed MODEL and its Download row; this half is a story about a
13	/// CREDENTIAL, somebody else's money and a cache. Interleaved they read as one
14	/// tangle, and the main file would be over its cap besides.
15	///
16	/// **Nothing here reads the on-device model list, the Download row or `language`.**
17	/// That is the whole point of the dispatch in the three methods next door: a
18	/// Mac with no on-device speech model can still transcribe in the cloud, and
19	/// this file is where that has to stay true.
20	///
21	/// **The controls are read in ONE place.** `runRequest()` is the function
22	/// from the card's state to what a run would receive, and everything else —
23	/// the estimate, the notes, the button, the run — goes through it, so the
24	/// summary can never describe a different request from the one Generate
25	/// sends. The vocabulary's rules are `TranscriptOptions.keyterms`, the same
26	/// function the tool uses and not a second copy of it.
27	extension TranscribeSheetController {

29	    // MARK: - The engine and its languages

31	    /// Read off the ITEM, never off the index — app/CLAUDE.md's popup rule.
32	    /// Anything unreadable is the on-device engine, which is what every build
33	    /// before road map 6 did.
34	    var engine: TranscriptionEngine {
35	        guard let raw = enginePopup.selectedItem?.representedObject as? String,
36	            let chosen = TranscriptionEngine(rawValue: raw)
37	        else { return .apple }
38	        return chosen
39	    }

41	    /// The Language popup for the chosen engine: every locale the on-device
42	    /// engine supports, a row with no model titled "— not installed", or
43	    /// "Detect automatically" and then §2's 21 codes by display name.
44	    ///
45	    /// The on-device arm is the code `loadView` carried before the Engine
46	    /// popup existed, moved here whole so switching back answers exactly what
47	    /// the card opened with.
48	    func populateLanguages() {
49	        languagePopup.removeAllItems()
50	        // A popup's menu validates its own rows, so this has to come BEFORE
51	        // any row is disabled or AppKit puts it straight back on.
52	        languagePopup.menu?.autoenablesItems = false
53	        languagePopup.isEnabled = true
54	        guard engine == .apple else {
55	            // "" is the code for DETECTION, which is the wire's absent
56	            // `language_code`, and it is the row the card opens on: a person
57	            // who has not said which language they are speaking is better
58	            // served by the service's own answer than by this Mac's locale.
59	            let detect = NSMenuItem(title: "Detect automatically", action: nil, keyEquivalent: "")
60	            detect.representedObject = ""
61	            languagePopup.menu?.addItem(detect)
62	            for entry in AssemblyAILanguages.all {

64	                item.representedObject = entry.code

74	                action: nil, keyEquivalent: "")

76	            item.representedObject = language.identifier

96	    /// §5e's two hint sentences, verbatim, with the region's own display name
97	    /// in the cloud one — the person is agreeing to a jurisdiction as much as

100	        -> String
101	    {
102	        switch engine {
103	        case .apple:
104	            return "The words are recognised ON THIS MAC and land as ordinary text clips on a "
105	                + "track of their own, so they show in the preview and burn into an export "
106	                + "with no further step. Nothing is uploaded."

114	    // MARK: - What the controls add up to
115	
116	    /// The card's state as what a run would be given — one value, so the
117	    /// readout, the notes, the button and Generate itself cannot disagree.
118	    struct RunRequest: Equatable {
119	        let engine: TranscriptionEngine
120	        /// The on-device locale identifier, and nil for the cloud engine.
121	        let appleLanguage: String?
122	        /// The cloud request, and nil for the on-device engine.
123	        let options: TranscriptOptions?
124	        let refresh: Bool
125	        /// How many terms were TYPED, before the trim, the de-duplication and
126	        /// the cap — `capNote` is the only reader.
127	        let vocabularyGiven: Int
128	    }
129	
130	    func runRequest() -> RunRequest {
131	        let chosen = engine
132	        guard chosen == .assemblyai else {
133	            return RunRequest(
134	                engine: .apple, appleLanguage: languagePopup.selectedItem?.representedObject
135	                    as? String, options: nil, refresh: false, vocabularyGiven: 0)
136	        }
137	        let vocabulary = Self.vocabulary(from: vocabularyField.stringValue)
138	        let code = languagePopup.selectedItem?.representedObject as? String
139	        return RunRequest(
140	            engine: .assemblyai, appleLanguage: nil,
141	            options: TranscriptOptions(
142	                speechModels: TranscriptOptions.shippedModels,
143	                languageCode: (code?.isEmpty ?? true) ? nil : code,
144	                speakerLabels: speakersCheckbox.state == .on,
145	                keytermsPrompt: vocabulary.terms),
146	            refresh: refreshCheckbox.state == .on, vocabularyGiven: vocabulary.given)
147	    }
148	
149	    /// The Vocabulary field as the tool's `vocabulary` argument: split on
150	    /// commas, then `TranscriptOptions.keyterms` — the SAME trim, the same
151	    /// de-duplication keeping the first spelling, the same cap. `given` is
152	    /// the count before any of that, which is what the tool's own note says.
153	    static func vocabulary(from text: String) -> (given: Int, terms: [String]) {
154	        guard !text.trimmingCharacters(in: .whitespacesAndNewlines).isEmpty else {
155	            return (0, [])
156	        }
157	        let pieces = text.split(separator: ",", omittingEmptySubsequences: false).map(String.init)
158	        return (pieces.count, TranscriptOptions.keyterms(pieces))
159	    }
160	
161	    /// The tool's own cap condition (`AgentServer+CloudCaptions.swift`'s
162	    /// `cloudTranscription`), read across: a list is CUT only when more were
163	    /// given than kept AND what was kept is exactly the ceiling. A list that
164	    /// shrank because it held duplicates or blanks lost nothing, and saying
165	    /// it was capped would send somebody looking for terms they never typed.
166	    static func capNote(given: Int, kept: Int) -> String? {
167	        guard given > kept, kept == AssemblyAIClient.maxKeyterms else { return nil }
168	        return "Vocabulary was capped at \(AssemblyAIClient.maxKeyterms) terms (AssemblyAI's "
169	            + "limit); \(given) were given."
170	    }

172	    // MARK: - The estimate
173	
174	    /// One `Facts` per media of the current scope, read from disk ONCE per
175	    /// media for the life of the sheet.
176	    ///
177	    /// `refresh` runs on every keystroke in the Vocabulary field, and a stat
178	    /// of two files per media per keystroke is a spin, not a readout. What
179	    /// the facts hold cannot change under an open sheet anyway: every editor
180	    /// action validates false while one is attached.
181	    func cloudFacts(for jobs: [Transcriber.Job]) -> [CloudEstimate.Facts] {
182	        guard let cache = document?.cacheDirectory else { return [] }
183	        var order: [UInt32] = []
184	        for job in jobs where !order.contains(job.media) { order.append(job.media) }
185	        let missing = jobs.filter { cloudFactsCache[$0.media] == nil }
186	        if !missing.isEmpty {
187	            var records: [UInt32: MediaSnapshot] = [:]
188	            for entry in snapshot.media { records[entry.id] = entry }
189	            for fact in CloudEstimate.facts(
190	                jobs: missing, media: records, cacheDirectory: cache)
191	            {
192	                cloudFactsCache[fact.media] = fact
193	            }
194	        }
195	        return order.compactMap { cloudFactsCache[$0] }
196	    }

198	    /// What this run would cost and why, or nil when the card is not in a
199	    /// state that can be priced — the on-device engine, or a document with
200	    /// nowhere to keep a cache.
201	    func cloudEstimate() -> CloudEstimate? {
202	        let request = runRequest()
203	        guard let options = request.options, document?.cacheDirectory != nil else { return nil }
204	        return CloudEstimate(
205	            facts: cloudFacts(for: jobs(in: scope)), options: options, refresh: request.refresh)
206	    }

210	    /// `refresh`'s cloud arm. Everything the settings state shows, recomputed
211	    /// from the controls, with nothing about a grant or an on-device model in
212	    /// it.
213	    func refreshCloud() {
214	        let jobs = self.jobs(in: scope)
215	        let estimate = cloudEstimate()
216	        let reusable = estimate?.canReuseWithoutCredential == true
217	        let hasCredential = ModelKeys.present(.assemblyAI, store: store, environment: environment)
218	        hintLabel.stringValue = !hasCredential && reusable
219	            ? "Current cached transcripts will be used without an API key or network request."
220	            : Self.hint(
221	                for: .assemblyai, region: AssemblyAIConfiguration.region(defaults: defaults))
222	        summaryLabel.stringValue = estimate
223	            .map { CloudEstimate.describe($0, fps: snapshot.canvas.fps) } ?? "Nothing to transcribe"
224	        // The WHY, where a person can reach it without it pushing the card
225	        // apart: one line per file that is not already transcribed, plus the
226	        // dated rate (R6-13 puts a held file's price on its own line).
227	        let reasons = estimate.map { CloudEstimate.reasons($0) } ?? []
228	        summaryLabel.toolTip = reasons.isEmpty ? nil : reasons.joined(separator: "\n")
229	        let note = cloudNoteText(jobs: jobs)
230	        noteLabel.stringValue = note
231	        noteLabel.isHidden = note.isEmpty
232	        let hasWork = estimate.map {
233	            !$0.uploads.isEmpty || !$0.cached.isEmpty || !$0.awaiting.isEmpty
234	        } ?? false
235	        let startEnabled =
236	            !jobs.isEmpty
237	            && document?.cacheDirectory != nil && (hasCredential ? hasWork : reusable)
238	        // CJ-12: with no key and no batch R6-16 admits, Start says which key.
239	        ModelKeys.mark(
240	            startButton, missing: !hasCredential && !reusable ? .assemblyAI : nil,
241	            enabled: startEnabled)
242	    }

244	    /// `noteText`'s cloud arm — the three things that are about the CALL and
245	    /// not about the audio: no credential, a vocabulary that was cut, and a
246	    /// scope holding nothing that can be transcribed.
247	    func cloudNoteText(jobs: [Transcriber.Job]) -> String {
248	        var notes: [String] = []
249	        if !ModelKeys.present(.assemblyAI, store: store, environment: environment),
250	            cloudEstimate()?.canReuseWithoutCredential != true
251	        {
252	            notes.append(ModelKeys.sentence(.assemblyAI))
253	        }
254	        if document?.cacheDirectory == nil {
255	            notes.append(
256	                "This project has nowhere to keep its transcript cache, so it cannot be "
257	                    + "transcribed with AssemblyAI. Save it first.")
258	        }
259	        let request = runRequest()
260	        if let cap = Self.capNote(
261	            given: request.vocabularyGiven, kept: request.options?.keytermsPrompt.count ?? 0)
262	        {
263	            notes.append(cap)
264	        }
265	        if jobs.isEmpty {
266	            notes.append(
267	                "Only a clip whose media has sound can be transcribed, and never one played in "
268	                    + "reverse.")
269	        }
270	        return notes.joined(separator: " ")
271	    }

273	    // MARK: - The run
274	
275	    /// The cloud run, on the same `CancelToken` the on-device one uses, so
276	    /// Stop cancels an upload or a wait exactly as it cancels a recognition.
277	    ///
278	    /// The transcriber is stored in `cloud` for its whole life: `run` hops
279	    /// onto its own serial queue under `[weak self]`, and a transcriber
280	    /// nobody retains never completes at all. Progress arrives on that queue
281	    /// and is hopped to main here, `ConsolidateProgressSheetController`'s
282	    /// shape and the on-device arm's.
283	    func beginCloud() {
284	        guard !didStart else { return }
285	        let request = runRequest()
286	        guard let options = request.options, let cache = document?.cacheDirectory
287	        else {
288	            NSSound.beep()
289	            return
290	        }
291	        let credential = AssemblyAIConfiguration.credential(
292	            store: store, environment: environment)
293	        var client: AssemblyAIClient?
294	        if let credential {
295	            do {
296	                let base = try AssemblyAIConfiguration.baseURL(defaults: defaults)
297	                client = AssemblyAIClient(base: base, credential: credential)
298	            } catch {
299	                // A misconfigured keyed endpoint is a result card.
300	                didStart = true
301	                showProgress()
302	                finish(.failure(error))
303	                return
304	            }
305	        }
306	        didStart = true
307	        let jobs = self.jobs(in: scope)
308	        showProgress()
309	        statusLabel.stringValue =
310	            "Transcribing \(jobs.count) clip\(jobs.count == 1 ? "" : "s") with AssemblyAI…"
311	        var records: [UInt32: MediaSnapshot] = [:]
312	        for entry in snapshot.media { records[entry.id] = entry }
313	        let run = CloudTranscriber(
314	            client: client,
315	            cacheDirectory: cache, media: records)
316	        cloud = run
317	        // A code the person NAMED comes back as itself; only an absent one
318	        // was detected, which is what makes a confidence figure honest.
319	        cloudDetected = options.languageCode == nil
320	        run.run(
321	            jobs: jobs, options: options, refresh: request.refresh,
322	            frame: max(snapshot.canvas.fps.frameDuration, 1), pages: pagesRequest, cancel: token,
323	            progress: { [weak self] fraction, name in
324	                DispatchQueue.main.async { self?.progressed(fraction, name) }
325	            },
326	            completion: { [weak self] outcome in
327	                guard let self = self else { return }
328	                self.finishCloud(outcome, report: run.report)
329	            })
330	    }
331	
332	    /// A Stop between worker success and main delivery still prevents placement.
333	    func finishCloud(
334	        _ outcome: Result<Transcriber.Outcome, any Error>, report: CloudTranscriber.Report
335	    ) {
336	        precondition(Thread.isMainThread)
337	        cloudReport = report
338	        if case .success = outcome, token.isCancelled {
339	            finish(.failure(Transcriber.TranscribeError.cancelled))
340	        } else {
341	            finish(outcome)
342	        }
343	    }
344	}

5	/// The run's one exit and the menu command that opens the sheet: `finish`,
6	/// the single place all four outcomes land (`summary` is the sentence it
7	/// writes), `viewDidDisappear`, which cancels a
8	/// run the sheet is dismissed out from under, and File ▸ Generate
9	/// Captions… itself with the validator arm that greys it.
10	///
11	/// A pure move out of `TranscribeSheetController.swift`, road map 6's C1
12	/// toll 3. Both blocks came here whole and in their own order, with every
13	/// line byte-identical. One widening in the move — `finish` is internal
14	/// rather than `private`, which the compiler forces, since `begin` stayed
15	/// behind and calls it — and nine in the file it left, the stored
16	/// properties `finish` and `viewDidDisappear` read. `summary` stays
17	/// `private`: only `finish` calls it, and it moved with it. W2 deleted
18	/// `truncationText` with the ceiling it reported (spec §11 W-8).
19	///
20	/// **c1-chrome added the cloud engine's three lines** (road map 6 §5e), and
21	/// it is no longer only a move. `cloudReportLines` turns the run's `Report`
22	/// into what the card says beside today's counts — R6-8's fallback, the
23	/// language that was DETECTED and how sure the service was, and any media
24	/// whose remote delete is still owed. They are added in BOTH arms: a run
25	/// that failed can still have uploaded one media and owe a delete for it,
26	/// and a card that printed only the error would lose the one record a
27	/// person has of that.
28	extension TranscribeSheetController {
29	
30	    // MARK: - Commit
31	
32	    /// The one exit for all four outcomes — finished, finished with something
33	    /// to say, failed and cancelled.
34	    ///
35	    /// The plan is built HERE, against the document's CURRENT handle, not
36	    /// against the snapshot this sheet opened with: recognition is minutes
37	    /// long and an agent can edit a document while a sheet is up, and
38	    /// `CaptionLayout.place` reads ids off a probe of the handle it is given.
39	    /// The commit goes through `performGroupedEdit` because a queue completion
40	    /// is not an AppKit event — the road map says `applyEdit` here, and
41	    /// following it would silently merge the captions into whatever edit came
42	    /// before them (app/CLAUDE.md's undo pitfall).
43	    func finish(_ outcome: Result<Transcriber.Outcome, any Error>) {
44	        guard !didFinish else { return }
45	        didFinish = true
46	        bar.doubleValue = 1
47	        stopButton.title = "Close"
48	        stopButton.isEnabled = true
49	        detailLabel.stringValue = ""
50	
51	        let cloudLines = cloudReport.map {
52	            Self.cloudReportLines($0, names: mediaNames, detected: cloudDetected)
53	        } ?? []
54	        let result: Transcriber.Outcome
55	        switch outcome {
56	        case .failure(let error):
57	            statusLabel.stringValue = ([error.localizedDescription] + cloudLines)
58	                .joined(separator: "\n")
59	            statusLabel.textColor = DS.textStrong
60	            return
61	        case .success(let value):
62	            result = value
63	        }
64	        guard let document = document else {
65	            statusLabel.stringValue = "The project closed before the captions could be placed."
66	            return
67	        }
68	        let plan: CaptionLayout.Plan
69	        do {
70	            let replacing = replaceExisting
71	                ? CaptionLayout.replaceableTracks(
72	                    in: document.editedProject.snapshot, jobs: jobs(in: scope))
73	                : []
74	            plan = try CaptionLayout.place(
75	                result.cues, problems: result.problems, in: document.editedProject,
76	                style: style, looks: looks, replacing: replacing)
77	        } catch {
78	            statusLabel.stringValue = error.localizedDescription
79	            statusLabel.textColor = DS.textStrong
80	            return
81	        }
82	        document.performGroupedEdit("Generate Captions", plan.ops)
83	
84	        // A clean run has nothing to say that the timeline does not already
85	        // show, so it leaves rather than making the user dismiss a receipt.
86	        guard plan.report.isEmpty, cloudLines.isEmpty else {
87	            statusLabel.stringValue =
88	                ([summary(plan), plan.report] + cloudLines)
89	                .filter { !$0.isEmpty }.joined(separator: "\n")
90	            statusLabel.textColor = DS.textStrong
91	            return
92	        }
93	        dismiss(self)
94	    }
95	
96	    /// The media names this sheet opened with, by id — the report card names
97	    /// FILES, because a person chose files and an id is the tool's
98	    /// vocabulary.
99	    private var mediaNames: [UInt32: String] {
100	        var out: [UInt32: String] = [:]
101	        for entry in snapshot.media { out[entry.id] = entry.name }
102	        return out
103	    }
104	
105	    /// The cloud run's extra lines, in a fixed order: R6-8's fallback, the
106	    /// detected language, what is still owed a delete, then any fetched
107	    /// transcript that could not be kept for reuse.
108	    ///
109	    /// The owed list is `Report.deletionWarnings`'s rule: once per media
110	    /// id, because a media can be in `janitorFailed` (an id owed from an
111	    /// earlier run) AND in `uploaded` with `remoteDeleted` false (one owed
112	    /// from this run), and saying it twice would read as two transcripts. A
113	    /// media R6-11 HELD gets one more clause, because "it will be retried"
114	    /// is only half of what happened to it.
115	    static func cloudReportLines(
116	        _ report: CloudTranscriber.Report, names: [UInt32: String], detected: Bool
117	    ) -> [String] {
118	        func name(_ id: UInt32) -> String { names[id] ?? "media \(id)" }
119	        var lines: [String] = []
120	        let preferred = TranscriptOptions.shippedModels.first ?? "universal-3-5-pro"
121	        for row in report.uploaded {
122	            guard let model = row.speechModelUsed, model != preferred else { continue }
123	            lines.append(
124	                "“\(name(row.media))” was transcribed with \(model), not \(preferred).")
125	        }
126	        if detected {
127	            for row in report.uploaded {
128	                guard let code = row.languageCode else { continue }
129	                let spoken = AssemblyAILanguages.entry(code: code)?.displayName ?? code
130	                guard let confidence = row.languageConfidence else {
131	                    lines.append("“\(name(row.media))”: detected \(spoken).")
132	                    continue
133	                }
134	                let percent = Int((min(max(confidence, 0), 1) * 100).rounded())
135	                lines.append(
136	                    "“\(name(row.media))”: detected \(spoken) (\(percent)% confidence).")
137	            }
138	        }
139	        lines.append(contentsOf: report.deletionWarnings { "“\(name($0))”" })
140	        lines.append(contentsOf: report.cacheWarnings { "“\(name($0))”" })
141	        return lines
142	    }
143	
144	    private func summary(_ plan: CaptionLayout.Plan) -> String {
145	        "\(plan.clips) caption\(plan.clips == 1 ? "" : "s") added"
146	            + (plan.trackName.map { " on “\($0)”." } ?? ".")
147	    }
148	
149	    override func viewDidDisappear() {
150	        super.viewDidDisappear()
151	        // A sheet that goes away mid-run must not leave a recognition holding
152	        // a temporary file and somebody's compute.
153	        if didStart, !didFinish { token.cancel() }
154	    }
155	}

157	// MARK: - The menu command
158	
159	/// The command half, at the foot of the file that owns the feature —
160	/// `CaptionImporter.swift`'s precedent, which keeps File ▸ Import Captions…
161	/// beside the importer it opens.
162	extension EditorViewController {
163	
164	    /// File ▸ Generate Captions… — the body of the frozen file's one-line
165	    /// `@objc func generateCaptions(_:)` forward.
166	    ///
167	    /// The refusal happens HERE rather than in the sheet, so a dialog whose
168	    /// only possible answer is "there is nothing with speech in it" never
169	    /// opens — `removeSilencesCommand`'s rule.
170	    func generateCaptionsCommand() {
171	        guard let document = document, view.window?.attachedSheet == nil else {
172	            NSSound.beep()
173	            return
174	        }
175	        guard Transcriber.hasTranscribableClip(in: document.editedProject.snapshot) else {
176	            NSSound.beep()
177	            return
178	        }
179	        // Recognition is minutes of somebody else's compute and the sheet is
180	        // up for all of it; a playhead running under it buys nothing.
181	        playback.pause()
182	        presentAsSheet(TranscribeSheetController(document: document))
183	    }
184	
185	    /// The half of `validateUserInterfaceItem` this file owns. nil means "not
186	    /// mine" and leaves the other answers alone.
187	    func validateTranscribeAction(_ action: Selector) -> Bool? {
188	        guard let document = document else { return false }
189	        switch action {
190	        case #selector(EditorViewController.generateCaptions(_:)):
191	            return Transcriber.hasTranscribableClip(in: document.editedProject.snapshot)
192	        default:
193	            return nil
194	        }
195	    }
196	}

5	/// The caption STYLE on the Generate Captions card — road map 8 §5e, W4b:
6	/// the Style popup, the preview under the looks row
7	/// (`TranscribeSheetController+Looks.swift`), and the "Replace existing
8	/// captions" checkbox with the list of what it will replace.
9	///
10	/// **The sheet commits what `transcribe {style, replace, slide, fill, dim}`
11	/// commits.** `style`, `replaceExisting`, `pagesRequest` and `looks` are the
12	/// four things `begin`, `beginCloud` and `finish` read, and they are computed
13	/// off the controls: the style off the popup's ITEM (app/CLAUDE.md's popup
14	/// rule), Replace only while the checkbox is live — which is the tool's two
15	/// rules read across (`AgentServer+Captions.swift`): a word style, and at
16	/// least one track `CaptionLayout.replaceableTracks` names — and each look
17	/// only while its box is enabled and on (spec §11 W-15).
18	///
19	/// **The preview is the renderer's own picture.** A sample page — the first
20	/// page `CaptionPages` makes of the scope's first clip's cached transcript,
21	/// else of `sampleText` — is laid out exactly as `place` would write it and
22	/// drawn by `LayerRenderers.textBitmap`, the routine the compositor uploads;
23	/// nothing is hand-drawn here but the plate and the scaling. A word style
24	/// shows two frames, the first and then the second word active — with a
25	/// ticked fill half done in both and a ticked pill half-way through its slide
26	/// in the second (`previewReveals`); the dim is not previewed. It is
27	/// redrawn only when its `PreviewKey` — the style, the first job's clip, the
28	/// canvas and the previewed looks — changes, so a keystroke in Vocabulary or
29	/// a click on Dim draws nothing.
30	///
31	/// **The style is remembered** under `CaptionStyle.defaultsKey`, read when
32	/// the popup is built and written when it changes, and never by the tool
33	/// (R6-2 read across). It is a display choice: not part of any transcript's
34	/// cache marker (R6-15), so a cached transcript stays a hit whatever is picked.

36	
37	    /// What the preview was last drawn for; `refreshStyleRow` redraws on a change only.
38	    /// `looks` are the PREVIEWED ones: `dim` is always false there.
39	    struct PreviewKey: Equatable {
40	        let style: CaptionStyle
41	        let clip: UInt32?
42	        let canvas: CGSize
43	        var looks = CaptionLooks.none
44	    }
45	
46	    /// How far through its fill the preview draws the active word.
47	    static let previewFill = 0.5
48	    /// The slide's progress in the preview: `easeOut(0.2)` is 0.488, the pill
49	    /// drawn half-way between the first word and the second.
50	    static let previewGlide = 0.2
51	
52	    /// The preview's size in points: column 1 of the grid, 420 − 44 − 106 − 12.
53	    static let previewSize = CGSize(width: 258, height: 80)
54	
55	    /// Sentence case: each style's own `textCase` uppercases it through
56	    /// `laidContent` (`WordProps.swift`), so Subtitles and Karaoke preview as
57	    /// written and the other four in capitals — as `transcribe` commits them.
58	    static let sampleText = "This is how it looks"
59	
60	    /// The chosen style, read off the item; anything unreadable is Subtitles.
61	    var style: CaptionStyle {
62	        guard let raw = stylePopup.selectedItem?.representedObject as? String else {
63	            return .subtitles
64	        }
65	        return CaptionStyle(rawValue: raw) ?? .subtitles
66	    }
67	
68	    /// Replace only while the checkbox is live: a disabled box replaces
69	    /// nothing, whatever state it was left in.

73	
74	    /// What each job's words are paged for: the style, on this canvas.
75	    var pagesRequest: CaptionPages.Request {

77	            style: style,
78	            canvas: CGSize(width: snapshot.canvas.width, height: snapshot.canvas.height))

81	    // MARK: - The three rows
82	
83	    /// Grid row 7: Subtitles, then the five word styles, in

106	
107	    /// Grid row 9: the preview, the full width of the controls column.
108	    func makePreviewRow() -> [NSView] {
109	        previewView.imageScaling = .scaleNone
110	        previewView.imageFrameStyle = .none
111	        previewView.widthAnchor.constraint(equalToConstant: Self.previewSize.width)

114	            .isActive = true

117	
118	    /// Grid row 10: the checkbox, and under it the tracks it will replace.
119	    func makeReplaceRow() -> [NSView] {
120	        replaceCheckbox.font = DS.sans(12)
121	        replaceCheckbox.target = self
122	        replaceCheckbox.action = #selector(controlChanged(_:))
123	        replaceLabel.font = DS.sans(11)

125	        replaceLabel.isEditable = false

134	    /// The Style popup: remember the choice, and recompute.
135	    @objc func styleChanged(_ sender: Any?) {
136	        defaults.set(style.rawValue, forKey: CaptionStyle.defaultsKey)
137	        refresh()
138	    }
139	
140	    /// The four rows' state, recomputed — `refresh()` calls it on the way
141	    /// out, whichever engine it dispatched to. The looks row first: the
142	    /// preview's key reads `looks`, which reads each box's `isEnabled`.
143	    func refreshStyleRow() {
144	        refreshLooksRow()
145	        let jobs = jobs(in: scope)
146	        let replaceable = CaptionLayout.replaceableTracks(in: snapshot, jobs: jobs)
147	        let live = style.isWordStyle && !replaceable.isEmpty
148	        replaceCheckbox.isEnabled = live
149	        if !live { replaceCheckbox.state = .off }
150	        replaceLabel.isHidden = !live
151	        replaceLabel.stringValue = live ? replaceText(replaceable) : ""
152	        var previewed = looks
153	        previewed.dim = false
154	        let key = PreviewKey(
155	            style: style, clip: jobs.first?.clip,
156	            canvas: CGSize(width: snapshot.canvas.width, height: snapshot.canvas.height),
157	            looks: previewed)

164	    /// "Replaces “Captions” (12 captions), “Captions 2” (3 captions)." — the
165	    /// tracks by name, in stack order, each with its clip count.
166	    private func replaceText(_ tracks: [UInt32]) -> String {
167	        let named = tracks.map { id -> String in
168	            let name = snapshot.tracks.first { $0.id == id }?.name ?? "track \(id)"
169	            let count = snapshot.clips.filter { $0.track == id }.count
170	            return "“\(name)” (\(count) caption\(count == 1 ? "" : "s"))"
171	        }
172	        return "Replaces " + named.joined(separator: ", ") + "."
173	    }

175	    // MARK: - The preview
176	
177	    /// `sampleText`'s five tokens, one every 0.3 s from 0, each 0.18 s long.
178	    static var fixedSampleWords: [CaptionCues.Word] {
179	        sampleText.split(separator: " ").enumerated().map { index, token in
180	            let start = Ticks(index) * 180_000
181	            return CaptionCues.Word(text: String(token), start: start, end: start + 108_000)
182	        }
183	    }
184	
185	    /// The words the preview pages: the first job's own words, up to twelve,
186	    /// when a cached transcript already has them, else `fixedSampleWords`.
187	    /// The ANSWER is cached per clip, a miss included — `refresh` runs per
188	    /// keystroke, and `MediaTranscript.read` is a disk read hit or miss.
189	    func sampleWords() -> [CaptionCues.Word] {
190	        guard let job = jobs(in: scope).first else { return Self.fixedSampleWords }
191	        if let cached = sampleWordsCache[job.clip] { return cached }
192	        var words: [CaptionCues.Word] = []
193	        if let directory = document?.cacheDirectory,
194	            let file = MediaTranscript.read(for: job.media, in: directory)
195	        {
196	            words = Array(MediaTranscript.captionWords(for: job, in: file).prefix(12))
197	        }
198	        let answer = words.isEmpty ? Self.fixedSampleWords : words
199	        sampleWordsCache[job.clip] = answer
200	        return answer
201	    }
202	
203	    /// The page's text props as `CaptionLayout.place` writes them: a word
204	    /// style's are `CaptionStyle.textProps` at the page's own size and width —
205	    /// the one construction the pager measured and `pagePatch` commits, with
206	    /// the sheet's `looks` as `place` is handed them — and Subtitles' are the
207	    /// Caption preset with its wrap box, mirrored.
208	    func previewProps(for cue: CaptionLayout.Cue, canvas: CGSize) -> TextProps {
209	        guard style.isWordStyle else {
210	            let preset = CaptionLayout.captionPreset
211	            return TextProps(
212	                content: cue.text, font: preset.font,
213	                size: preset.size(on: canvas),
214	                align: preset.align, valign: "middle", backdrop: preset.backdrop,
215	                width: Double(canvas.width) * CaptionLayout.wrapFraction)
216	        }
217	        return style.textProps(
218	            content: cue.text, size: cue.size ?? style.size(for: canvas), width: cue.width,
219	            looks: looks)
220	    }
221	
222	    /// A word style's two preview frames: the first word active, then the
223	    /// second (the first again on a one-word page), each with the fill at
224	    /// `previewFill` when Fill is on, and the second with the pill at
225	    /// `previewGlide` when Slide is on and there is a word to slide from.
226	    static func previewReveals(tokens: Int, looks: CaptionLooks) -> [RecipeReveal] {
227	        let fill = looks.fill ? previewFill : nil
228	        let glide = looks.slide && tokens >= 2 ? previewGlide : nil
229	        return [
230	            RecipeReveal(word: 1, wordPop: 1, wordFill: fill),
231	            RecipeReveal(word: min(2, tokens), wordPop: 1, wordGlide: glide, wordFill: fill),
232	        ]
233	    }
234	
235	    /// The sample page drawn by the renderer: two frames for a word style
236	    /// (`previewReveals`), one for Subtitles, each
237	    /// scaled to fit a 258×36 slot, stacked 8 pt apart over the plate, at 2×.
238	    func preview() -> NSImage? {
239	        let canvas = CGSize(width: snapshot.canvas.width, height: snapshot.canvas.height)
240	        let frame = max(snapshot.canvas.fps.frameDuration, 1)
241	        guard
242	            let cue = CaptionPages.samplePage(
243	                sampleWords(), request: pagesRequest, frame: frame)
244	        else { return nil }
245	        let props = previewProps(for: cue, canvas: canvas)
246	        let reveals =
247	            style.isWordStyle
248	            ? Self.previewReveals(tokens: props.tokenCount, looks: looks)
249	            : [RecipeReveal.whole]
250	        let size = Self.previewSize
251	        let scale: CGFloat = 2
252	        guard
253	            let context = LayerRenderers.bitmap(
254	                CGSize(width: size.width * scale, height: size.height * scale))
255	        else { return nil }
256	        context.setFillColor(DS.captionPreviewPlate.cgColor)
257	        context.fill(CGRect(x: 0, y: 0, width: context.width, height: context.height))
258	        context.scaleBy(x: scale, y: scale)
259	        context.interpolationQuality = .high
260	
261	        let slot = CGSize(width: size.width, height: 36)
262	        let gap: CGFloat = 8
263	        let count = CGFloat(reveals.count)
264	        // From the TOP, in points; the context is y-up.
265	        var top = (size.height - count * slot.height - (count - 1) * gap) / 2
266	        for reveal in reveals {
267	            if let bitmap = LayerRenderers.textBitmap(props, reveal: reveal),
268	                let image = bitmap.makeImage()
269	            {
270	                let fit = min(
271	                    slot.width / CGFloat(image.width), slot.height / CGFloat(image.height))
272	                let drawn = CGSize(
273	                    width: CGFloat(image.width) * fit, height: CGFloat(image.height) * fit)
274	                context.draw(
275	                    image,
276	                    in: CGRect(
277	                        x: (size.width - drawn.width) / 2,
278	                        y: size.height - top - slot.height + (slot.height - drawn.height) / 2,
279	                        width: drawn.width, height: drawn.height))
280	            }
281	            top += slot.height + gap
282	        }
283	        guard let image = context.makeImage() else { return nil }
284	        return NSImage(cgImage: image, size: size)
285	    }
286	}

5	/// The three LOOKS on the Generate Captions card (spec §11 W-15, issue batch
6	/// B86): "Slide the pill", "Fill words as spoken" and "Dim in pauses", one
7	/// per line under the Style popup and above the preview, and the note about
8	/// on-device pauses under them.
9	///
10	/// **A box that does not apply is greyed, not hidden, and keeps its tick.**
11	/// `refreshLooksRow()` sets each box's `isEnabled` from
12	/// `CaptionLooks.Look.isLive(for:)` and never its state, so Slide ticked on
13	/// Pill is still ticked after a trip through Karaoke; `looks` counts a box
14	/// only while it is ENABLED and on, which is what `finish` hands `place` and
15	/// what the preview draws.
16	///
17	/// **Each box is remembered under its own key**, read when the row is built
18	/// and written by a CLICK (`lookChanged`) — never by Generate — and never by
19	/// the tool (R6-2 read across). An absent key is off, so a build that
20	/// remembered only a style opens with all three off.
21	///
22	/// **The note** shows whenever On this Mac is the engine and Dim is live (a
23	/// word style), ticked or not: the on-device engine's word ranges tile the
24	/// audio, so its words rarely carry the pause a dim waits for (W-13). It
25	/// wraps to two lines at the column's width, so the card is about two lines
26	/// taller while it shows.
27	extension TranscribeSheetController {
28	
29	    /// The owner's sentence (spec §11 W-15).
30	    static let dimNote = "On-device words rarely carry a pause; this shows mostly with AssemblyAI."
31	
32	    /// The looks a run commits: each box ENABLED and on.
33	    var looks: CaptionLooks {
34	        var out = CaptionLooks.none
35	        for look in CaptionLooks.Look.allCases {
36	            let box = checkbox(for: look)
37	            out[look] = box.isEnabled && box.state == .on
38	        }
39	        return out
40	    }
41	
42	    func checkbox(for look: CaptionLooks.Look) -> NSButton {
43	        switch look {
44	        case .slide: return slideCheckbox
45	        case .fill: return fillCheckbox
46	        case .dim: return dimCheckbox
47	        }
48	    }
49	
50	    /// Grid row 8: the three boxes stacked, each opening on its remembered
51	    /// state, and the note. `makeReplaceRow()` is the pattern.
52	    func makeLooksRow() -> [NSView] {

54	        for look in CaptionLooks.Look.allCases {

58	            box.target = self

78	    /// A click on one box: remember THAT box's state under its own key, and

93	            checkbox(for: look).isEnabled = look.isLive(for: style)

3	// MARK: - Sheet: the Download row
4	
5	/// The row under Language that installs an on-device model — spec §11 W-8,
6	/// road map 8 §5f. It shows for a supported language whose model is not on
7	/// this Mac, and while a download runs; a person presses Download, watches the
8	/// bar, and may press Cancel.
9	///
10	/// **A download is a person's act, never a tool's** (R6-12's argument read
11	/// across): this row is `SpeechEngine.download`'s only caller, and the
12	/// `transcribe` tool refuses an uninstalled locale by name instead.
13	///
14	/// **The bar is indeterminate until the download says how big it is.** W0 q3
15	/// read the request's `Progress` before any download: zero units, zero
16	/// fraction. So the row names no size and no percentage until
17	/// `totalUnitCount` is positive, and then shows the fraction.
18	///
19	/// **Both popups are LOCKED while a download runs.** Changing the language
20	/// mid-download would hide the only Cancel or show one locale's bar under
21	/// another's name, and changing the engine would repopulate Language under
22	/// it; `downloading` names the locale the running download is for and the
23	/// row reads that, never the popup. The lock is applied in
24	/// `refreshDownloadRow()`, AFTER `populateLanguages()` has set the popup's
25	/// own `isEnabled` — never inside it.
26	///
27	/// **Closing the sheet mid-download is a decision, not code**: the download
28	/// runs on in the framework, and the observation dies with this controller
29	/// (`[weak self]`).
30	extension TranscribeSheetController {
31	
32	    /// Grid row 1: an empty label cell, and the button, the bar and the
33	    /// label in one stack.
34	    func makeDownloadRow() -> [NSView] {
35	        let button = NSButton(
36	            title: "Download", target: self, action: #selector(downloadClicked(_:)))
37	        button.bezelStyle = .rounded
38	        button.controlSize = .small
39	        button.font = DS.sans(12)
40	        let bar = NSProgressIndicator()
41	        bar.style = .bar
42	        bar.controlSize = .small
43	        bar.minValue = 0
44	        bar.maxValue = 1
45	        bar.isIndeterminate = true
46	        bar.widthAnchor.constraint(equalToConstant: 80).isActive = true
47	        let label = NSTextField(labelWithString: "")
48	        label.font = DS.sans(11)
49	        label.textColor = DS.textMuted
50	        label.lineBreakMode = .byTruncatingTail
51	        downloadButton = button
52	        downloadBar = bar
53	        downloadLabel = label
54	        let stack = NSStackView(views: [button, bar, label])
55	        stack.orientation = .horizontal
56	        stack.alignment = .centerY
57	        stack.spacing = 8
58	        return [fieldLabel(""), stack]
59	    }
60	
61	    /// The row's whole state, recomputed — `refresh()` calls it last, and
62	    /// every progress hop ends in it.
63	    func refreshDownloadRow() {
64	        guard let grid = grid, let button = downloadButton, let bar = downloadBar,
65	            let label = downloadLabel
66	        else { return }
67	        let running = downloading
68	        let visible = running != nil || (engine == .apple && language?.installed == false)
69	        if grid.numberOfRows > 1 { grid.row(at: 1).isHidden = !visible }
70	        guard let running else {
71	            button.title = "Download"
72	            button.isEnabled = true
73	            bar.isHidden = true
74	            bar.stopAnimation(nil)
75	            label.stringValue = ""
76	            return
77	        }
78	        languagePopup.isEnabled = false
79	        enginePopup.isEnabled = false
80	        button.title = "Cancel"
81	        // Nothing to cancel until the request's `Progress` has arrived: a
82	        // Cancel pressed before it would do nothing and the download run on.
83	        button.isEnabled = downloadProgress != nil
84	        bar.isHidden = false
85	        var text = "Downloading \(running.displayName)…"
86	        if let progress = downloadProgress, progress.totalUnitCount > 0 {
87	            bar.stopAnimation(nil)
88	            bar.isIndeterminate = false
89	            bar.doubleValue = min(max(progress.fractionCompleted, 0), 1)
90	            text += " \(Int(progress.fractionCompleted * 100))%"
91	        } else {
92	            bar.isIndeterminate = true
93	            bar.startAnimation(nil)
94	        }
95	        label.stringValue = text
96	    }
97	
98	    /// Download when none runs; Cancel the running one otherwise.
99	    @objc func downloadClicked(_ sender: Any?) {
100	        guard downloading == nil else {
101	            downloadProgress?.cancel()
102	            return
103	        }
104	        guard engine == .apple, let chosen = language, !chosen.installed else {
105	            NSSound.beep()
106	            return
107	        }
108	        downloading = chosen
109	        refreshDownloadRow()
110	        SpeechEngine.download(
111	            chosen.locale,
112	            progress: { [weak self] progress in self?.observe(progress) },
113	            completion: { [weak self] result in self?.downloadFinished(result) })
114	    }
115	
116	    /// Holds the request's `Progress` and watches its two numbers, each
117	    /// change hopped to main and ending in `refreshDownloadRow()`.
118	    private func observe(_ progress: Progress) {
119	        downloadProgress = progress
120	        downloadObservation = progress.observe(
121	            \.fractionCompleted, options: [.new]
122	        ) { [weak self] _, _ in
123	            DispatchQueue.main.async { self?.refreshDownloadRow() }
124	        }
125	        refreshDownloadRow()
126	    }
127	
128	    /// The completion's one-line forward. The downloaded locale is captured
129	    /// BEFORE `populateLanguages()` reselects the default, and selected
130	    /// again after it. A cancel is not reported; any other failure is one
131	    /// line in the note until the next refresh.
132	    func downloadFinished(_ result: Result<Void, any Error>) {
133	        let identifier = downloading?.identifier
134	        let cancelled = downloadProgress?.isCancelled ?? false
135	        downloading = nil
136	        downloadProgress = nil
137	        downloadObservation = nil
138	        enginePopup.isEnabled = true
139	        switch result {
140	        case .success:
141	            Transcriber.forgetLanguages()
142	            languages = Transcriber.supportedLanguages()
143	            populateLanguages()
144	            if let identifier { select(languageIdentifier: identifier) }
145	            refresh()
146	        case .failure(let error):
147	            populateLanguages()
148	            if let identifier { select(languageIdentifier: identifier) }
149	            refresh()
150	            guard !cancelled, !(error is CancellationError) else { return }
151	            noteLabel.stringValue = "The download did not finish: \(error.localizedDescription)"
152	            noteLabel.isHidden = false
153	        }
154	    }
155	
156	    /// Selects the Language row whose identifier this is; a miss keeps
157	    /// whatever `populateLanguages()` chose.
158	    func select(languageIdentifier: String) {
159	        if let index = languagePopup.itemArray.firstIndex(where: {
160	            $0.representedObject as? String == languageIdentifier
161	        }) {
162	            languagePopup.selectItem(at: index)
163	        }
164	    }
165	}
